title: Cover DataExportImportService._resolveScheduleJson's weekly/rolling/new-schema branches (3 of 4 paths untested)
rule: TQ-8 (assertions weaker than what the source can do wrong)
area: features/settings domain service, tested across 7 files in this batch
why: _resolveScheduleJson exists specifically to keep old backup files importable across the W3.27 schema migration -- exactly the scenario a real user hits restoring a pre-migration backup. A repo-wide grep across all 7 domain/services test files in this batch for 'scheduleType', a literal 'schedule' key, 'rollingWindowSize', and 'daysOfWeek' returns zero hits: every stage-definition test fixture omits both the old quartet and the new field, so every test silently exercises only the `default: delay` fallback branch. A bug in the weekly/rolling legacy-parsing logic (e.g. the `jsonDecode(days) as List` cast, or a rolling-window field-name mismatch) would silently produce a wrong-but-plausible study schedule on restore, and nothing in this test suite would catch it.
recommendation: Add tests importing legacy-quartet payloads with scheduleType: 'weekly' (including a JSON-string-encoded daysOfWeek and a native-List one) and 'rolling', plus one with the new 'schedule' field pre-populated, asserting the resulting stage_definitions.schedule column.
acceptance_criteria: 3 new tests exist covering the weekly, rolling, and new-schedule-field branches.
Each new test fails when _resolveScheduleJson's corresponding branch is deliberately broken (red-first check).

corrections: Minor: 'case 'weekly':' is actually at line 922, not 921 as cited (rolling at 928 is exact). Quote text itself is correct and uniquely locatable.
